items.text: There are no cameras and no live view at this address. Responders get no visual verification before arrival.

confidence.basis: CHEKT: no devices on record for site 35801; consequence follows directly
confidence.failure_risk: Owner has non-CHEKT cameras (doorbell etc.) not visible to responders

items.text: Corner lot with two street frontages (NW Celilo Ln on the W, the collector on the N). Both are public approaches.

confidence.basis: Clear top-down + 4 tilts; house sits between Celilo and the collector
confidence.failure_risk: N side may be a rear lot line with wall/no vehicle access (still a foot approach)

items.text: The E/NE side opens onto undeveloped native land with no fence or gate identifiable. Approach from there is unobserved.

confidence.basis: Imagery 6/22/2024 shows native tract; fences are hard to resolve overhead
confidence.failure_risk: Subdivision was building out in 2024: tract may be developed by now; low fence present

confidence.basis: Narrow side yard is clear in imagery; entry location is a guess from pad/walk layout
confidence.failure_risk: Front door could face Celilo further S or be on the N frontage

A.title: Access
A.status: Access + emergency response  ·  pad off NW Celilo Ln (W)  ·  meet at the T, 22 m away  ·  stage on the collector  ·  ambulance fits the pad  ·  3 ways out  ·  no turnaround
A.legend:
Yellow = approach route  ·  Green = pad  ·  Yellow bars = GE ruler
Purple = staging  ·  White/red box = ambulance (to scale)
Cyan dashed = on foot (patient path, rear access)
Orange ring = meet point  ·  Green arrows = egress

items.text: Arrive on the collector (likely NW Skyline Ranch Rd, verify) and turn onto NW Celilo Ln at the T; the drive is 22 m (73 ft) from the T on the left. The T is the meet / ground-guide point, not a rated LZ.

confidence.basis: Ruler 22.3 m; T geometry clear. The collector name is unverified and the arrival direction depends on dispatch routing
confidence.failure_risk: Wrong road name in a dispatch note; units arrive from the S on Celilo

items.confirm_by: Road-name check (county GIS / Google Maps); Bend Fire routing

items.text: Driveway pad: 17.2 m (56 ft) street edge to garage face, 6.2 m (20 ft) wide at the mouth. An ambulance fits; there is no turnaround. Patient path: front entry / garage to the pad.

confidence.basis: Ruler 17.2 m and 6.2 m vs a typical ambulance (~7–7.5 m × 2.6 m with mirrors): fits with room
confidence.failure_risk: Cars parked on the pad (2 in the imagery); slope; the 17.2 m includes apron/sidewalk

items.text: Celilo is 11.5 m (38 ft) curb to curb with cars parked on both sides, so do not stage there. Stage in the collector curb / bike lane E of the T along the N frontage.

confidence.basis: Ruler 11.5 m − 2 × ~2.2 m parked ≈ 7 m clear (sound). Collector bike lane ~1.5–2 m is narrower than an engine (~2.6 m)
confidence.failure_risk: Staging in the bike lane intrudes on a travel lane; the agency may prefer Celilo or the T

items.text: Three ways out: the collector NW, the collector SE, and Celilo S/SW. The rear (E) side is reachable on foot across the N strip and lawn; gate status unknown.

confidence.basis: Road network seen in 2024 context imagery; foot route clear overhead
confidence.failure_risk: New streets or closures since 2024; fence/gate blocks the N strip

items.text: Back the ambulance onto the pad (nose out toward Celilo), or nose in and reverse out with a spotter. Engines and ladders work from the street or the collector.

confidence.basis: Pad geometry (ruler) supports it; tactics are the crew's call
confidence.failure_risk: Crew SOP differs; pad occupied

items.text: Keep the T clear for ground-guiding and agree any LZ with the agency. If fire is in the E/SE tract, evacuate W via Celilo or along the collector, away from the fuel.

confidence.basis: Fuel is clearly E/SE in imagery; LZ deferred to the agency
confidence.failure_risk: Wind or fire location makes W the wrong way

items.text: Add a Knox box / lockbox (none visible in imagery; verify), confirm whether a side gate exists to the rear yard, and post house numbers visible from both streets.

confidence.basis: Mostly verification asks; low risk
confidence.failure_risk: Items already in place

items.text: With no cameras, dispatch has no visual on arrival (see S). Verify the collector name and the front-entry location on a site visit.

confidence.basis: CHEKT no-device record plus verification ask
